research_question: What is the strongest defensible interoperability claim Genesis can make for each of: OpenBot, OpenDots, OpenMuse, MCP, AG-UI, A2A, Jev?
method: Structured review of EXISTING persisted evidence. NO new external calls authorized (per Section 23 default). NO new code executed.

integrations.purpose: Execution/computer runtime (worker shell + browser + workspace files)
integrations.scope: Real OpenBot invoked across 3 blind natural missions (Phase 4.8A/C/E) with real LLM (llm-glm-4-plus). Shell-execution, workspace-files, and browser-chromium domains exercised.
limitations: In-flight recovery (H-08 OpenBot disconnect reconnect) NOT proven — deferred per G6-01.
Runtime unavailable health check (H-07) NOT proven — deferred per G6-01; applies to real OpenBot only.
Production-scale authentication not proven.
integrations.approved_public_wording: Real OpenBot integration was demonstrated across 3 blind natural missions with real LLM (llm-glm-4-plus), exercising shell-execution, workspace-files, and browser-chromium domains.
prohibited_wording: Genesis fully supports OpenBot in production
OpenBot in-flight recovery is proven
OpenBot is the production runtime (it is optional)

integrations.scope: Real OpenDots invoked across Phase 4.6 (probe PASS, mission failure due to verification gate) and Phase 4.8A/E (page creation, retrieval, multi-worker contribution).
limitations: Phase 4.6 probe PASS but mission status failure (verification gate unrelated to OpenDots itself).
Production-scale federation not proven.
integrations.approved_public_wording: Real OpenDots integration was demonstrated across Phase 4.6 and Phase 4.8A/E missions with real LLM, exercising shared page creation and retrieval.
prohibited_wording: OpenDots is production-ready for arbitrary collaborative workloads
Genesis integrates seamlessly with all OpenDots deployments

integrations.scope: Real OpenMuse invoked in Phase 4.8E blind mission (durable result agreed with OpenBot computer). Phase 4.8C declared OpenMuse available but did not invoke it.
limitations: In-flight job recovery (H-22) NOT proven — deferred per G6-01; applies to real OpenMuse only.
Phase 4.8C declared OpenMuse available but Invoked=false despite mission requesting durable delegation — observed limitation, not fixed.
Queued recovery proven; in-flight recovery NOT proven.
integrations.approved_public_wording: Real OpenMuse integration was demonstrated in Phase 4.8E with real LLM (llm-glm-4-plus), exercising durable delegated job execution whose result agreed with the OpenBot computer.
prohibited_wording: OpenMuse in-flight recovery is proven
Genesis fully supports OpenMuse job queues in production

integrations.scope: Local MCP server (server.ts) demonstrated positive (authorized worker invokes analyze tool, correct sum computed) and negative (unauthorized worker blocked, grant refusal recorded, no false success) paths.
limitations: Local reference MCP server only — not a real third-party MCP server.
No production-scale MCP federation proven.
No universal MCP compatibility claim — only the MCP SDK integration is proven.
integrations.approved_public_wording: MCP-based tool interoperability was demonstrated with a local reference MCP server: authorized workers invoke tools correctly, unauthorized workers are blocked with grant refusal, and no false success occurs.
prohibited_wording: Genesis integrates with any MCP server
Genesis fully supports MCP in production
Universal MCP compatibility is proven

integrations.scope: AG-UI v1.0 protocol emission demonstrated: 13 ordered event types emitted correctly, consumer reconstructs run, results match. Failure probe (worker exhausts budget) emits RUN_ERROR; consumer sees failure; no false success.
limitations: In-process consumer only — not a real AG-UI application.
No production-scale AG-UI streaming proven.
No real third-party AG-UI consumer tested.
integrations.approved_public_wording: AG-UI-compatible execution events are emitted by Genesis in the correct AG-UI v1.0 protocol order, and a consumer can reconstruct the run including failure cases without false success.
prohibited_wording: Genesis integrates seamlessly with all AG-UI applications
AG-UI streaming is production-proven

integrations.scope: A2A outbound federation demonstrated against an independent local reference agent (server.mjs). Three probes: (A) success — agent returns correct hash, Genesis verifies; (B) failure — agent returns FAILED, Genesis remains truthful; (C) trust-boundary — agent claims success with WRONG hash, Genesis verification rejects (A2A RESULT ≠ VERIFIED GENESIS FACT).
limitations: Outbound federation only — inbound federation deferred per G6-02 Section 21.
Reference agent uses no auth — production authentication not proven.
Only local reference-agent interoperability proven, not a real third-party A2A agent.
Polling-based (not streaming).
No retry on sendMessage (prevents duplicate remote tasks).
integrations.approved_public_wording: Outbound A2A interoperability was demonstrated against an independent local reference agent. The trust-boundary invariant (A2A RESULT ≠ VERIFIED GENESIS FACT) is proven: an external agent claiming success with wrong content does not become Genesis verified success.
prohibited_wording: Genesis integrates seamlessly with all A2A agents
A2A inbound federation is proven
A2A production authentication is proven
Genesis federates with arbitrary external agents in production

integrations.integration: Jev (Decision Model via OpenRouter Decisions API)
integrations.scope: Real Jev Decision Model (typesafe/jev-1.13) via OpenRouter Decisions API (EU endpoint). G6-03B positive causal probe: real Jev decision ('default', prob 0.82, conf 0.73) causally wired into Genesis genome compilation, mission succeeded, $0.000016296 observed cost. G6-03 benchmark: 27/29 correctness on main-run corpus, 7 failure-truthfulness probes all PASS.
limitations: Jev is OPTIONAL — production default is RuleDecisionProvider.
Jev correctness NOT strictly superior to Rule on the benchmark corpus (27/29 each; different failures).
Jev adds cost ($0.00738187 total / 34 calls) and latency (avg 3448ms vs Rule's 0.069ms).
Response schema INFERRED_NOT_VERIFIED due to historical 403 geo-restriction (resolved by G6-03B EU endpoint).
Jev Router (chat-completions product) was tested in G6-03 but is NOT the same as Jev Decision Model — G6-03A corrected this; G6-03B provided the positive causal proof.
No new Jev calls authorized in G6-05.
integrations.approved_public_wording: Real Jev Decision Model integration is proven: a real Jev decision (typesafe/jev-1.13 via OpenRouter Decisions API EU endpoint) is causally wired into Genesis genome compilation with mission success. Jev remains an OPTIONAL DecisionProvider; the production default is RuleDecisionProvider.
prohibited_wording: Jev outperforms Rule
Rule outperforms Jev based on the historical Router benchmark
Jev is the production default DecisionProvider
Genesis relies on Jev for bounded probabilistic decisions

summary.key_finding: Genesis has demonstrated real-provider integration for OpenBot, OpenDots, OpenMuse, and Jev; reference integration for MCP, AG-UI, and A2A. NO integration has been proven at production scale. The trust-boundary invariant (A2A RESULT ≠ VERIFIED GENESIS FACT) is the strongest interoperability invariant.

evidence_level_justification: Audit of existing persisted evidence; no new external calls. Each integration's evidence level reflects its strongest supporting component.
